title: The Man Who Collects Secrets
main_content:
Some people collect postage stamps – the small pieces of paper you place on letters or postcards before mailing them. Other people collect works of art, antiques or musical instruments. But a man in the American state of Maryland collects secrets.

For the past 10 years, people from throughout the world have been sending Frank Warren postcards and other objects with secrets written on them. He now has a million secrets.

Mr. Warren lives in Germantown, Maryland, near Washington, D.C. Ten years ago, he created an art project he calls “Post Secret.”

People send him postcards, other objects and emails telling their secrets.

He has published six books full of the secrets people have shared with him. One secret in each book is his.

The project itself was once one of Mr. Warren’s secrets. His wife Jan did not know exactly what he was doing until the first book was published.

Some people tell Frank Warren of their secret desire to kill themselves. So he and the Post Secret community have raised more than $1 million to help prevent suicides.

options: A type of artwork used for decoration
Labels placed on packages to indicate postage

questions.question: What does Frank Warren collect?
options: Secrets shared by people around the world
questions.answer: Secrets shared by people around the world

options: To publish more books of secrets
To support art projects across the country
